ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a discrete-time feedback system. The input on the left is X, which passes through an addition node and then enters the forward-channel block; the system function labeled inside the block is K/(z^2+z-2). The output is Y, and there is a feedback branch from the output terminal back to the lower end of the addition node, with a negative sign marked beside the feedback end, so this is a unity negative-feedback structure. Reasoning: According to the forward transfer function in the figure, take G(z)=K/(z^2+z-2). The characteristic equation of the unity negative-feedback closed loop is 1+G(z)=0, that is z^2+z-2+K=0, which becomes z^2+z+(K-2)=0. For the second-order discrete-time polynomial z^2+a1 z+a2, use the Jury stability conditions, where a1=1, a2=K-2. The conditions give K>0, K-2>0, and K<3, combined to obtain 2<K<3. So a=2, b=3, a+b=5.

method.method_draft: From the image set G(z)=K/(z^2+z-2) with unity negative feedback. The closed-loop characteristic equation is z^2+z-2+K=0, i.e. z^2+z+(K-2). Apply the Jury conditions with a1=1 and a2=K-2: K>0, K-2>0, and K<3. Combine to get 2<K<3, so a=2 and b=3, hence a+b=5.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个离散时间反馈系统，左侧输入为 X，经过一个加法结点后进入前向通道方框；方框内标注的系统函数为 K/(z^2+z-2)。输出为 Y，并且输出端有一条反馈支路回到加法结点的下端，反馈端旁标有负号，因此这是单位负反馈结构。推理：按图中前向传递函数取 G(z)=K/(z^2+z-2)。单位负反馈闭环的特征方程为 1+G(z)=0，即 z^2+z-2+K=0，化为 z^2+z+(K-2)=0。对二阶离散时间多项式 z^2+a1 z+a2 使用 Jury 稳定条件，其中 a1=1，a2=K-2。条件给出 K>0、K-2>0 且 K<3，合并得到 2<K<3。所以 a=2，b=3，a+b=5。

method.method_draft: Form the closed-loop characteristic polynomial from the negative-feedback diagram: z^2+z-2+K=0. Solve its roots: z=(-1±sqrt(9-4K))/2. Analyze when both roots have magnitude less than 1. For K≤2, one pole reaches or exceeds the unit-circle boundary, with K=2 giving poles 0 and -1, so stability needs K>2. For K>9/4 the poles are complex conjugates with product K-2, so their common magnitude is sqrt(K-2), requiring K<3; the intervening real-root interval 2<K≤9/4 also stays inside the unit circle. Thus the complete stability interval is 2<K<3, giving a+b=5.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个离散时间负反馈系统。输入为 X，经过一个加法节点后进入前向通道方框；加法节点处输入 X 为正号，来自输出端的反馈信号为负号。方框中的系统函数标为 K/(z^2+z-2)，输出为 Y，输出信号沿下方回路反馈到加法节点的负端。

推理：该系统为单位负反馈，前向通道为 G(z)=K/(z^2+z-2)。闭环特征方程由 1+G(z)=0 得到：z^2+z-2+K=0。其根为 z=(-1±sqrt(9-4K))/2。离散时间因果 LTI 系统稳定要求闭环极点都在单位圆内。
当 K=2 时，特征方程为 z^2+z=0，极点为 0 和 -1，其中 -1 在单位圆边界上，不稳定；因此需要 K>2。对 2<K≤9/4，两个实根从 0 和 -1 向 -1/2 靠近，均在单位圆内。对 K>9/4，极点为共轭复根，其乘积为 K-2，因此每个极点的模为 sqrt(K-2)，稳定要求 sqrt(K-2)<1，即 K<3。所以稳定区间为 2<K<3，即 a=2、b=3，故 a+b=5。
